svg.metadata: Ferrosift retrofit module M02; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Acquisition / control and interface package
svg.text: Mechanical envelopes only. No selected electronics, safety architecture or released circuit design.
Separate acquisition/control enclosure, internal component envelopes, removable cover, connector access and supported cable routes.
The modeled volume does not verify heat rejection or EMC.
HOST ACTUATION IS OUTSIDE THIS MODULE
Ejectors, air supply, diverters, bins and conveyor drive are not supplied by this concept. Any future command interface needs agreed timing,
fail-safe behavior and a line-level safety review.
Select excitation frequencies, power, low-noise receivers, digitizers, timing, shielding, grounding, isolation and EMC strategy. Establish
temperature stability, calibration and self-test before defining the enclosure and harness.
Existing computer-vision annotation-recall results are separate from this unbuilt sensing module. They are not physical copper recovery,
purity, payback or proof of a benefit from multi-angle sensing.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE PER VIEW AT A3 | PROPOSED RESEARCH GEOMETRY
No approved fit, tolerance, load, electromagnetic coverage, throughput or safeguarding rating.
